Meta.title: Phronesis - Practical wisdom for AI agent systems
Meta.description: Phronesis is an open source Python framework for building AI agent systems with typed contracts, composable execution patterns, and observability built in.
Meta.ogDescription: Open source Python framework for AI agent systems. Typed contracts, composable pipelines, observability built in.

Hero.heading: Practical wisdom for AI agent systems.

Why.heading: An agent is not a chatbot with tools.
Why.p1AfterStrong: with judgment in concrete situations. That is
Why.p1End: . Most agent frameworks treat agents as enhanced chatbots glued to a tool-use loop. Phronesis treats them as deliberating systems with explicit contracts: typed inputs, declared effects, bounded memory, named execution patterns.
Why.p2Before: Existing frameworks force a choice. On one side, you write arbitrary control flow as code: maximal expressiveness, and a multi-agent system that nobody can debug six months later. On the other, everything is described in YAML or graph-builders: legible at a glance, impossible the moment you need something non-trivial. Phronesis separates declarative specification from runtime execution. Agents, tools, memory, pipelines are
Why.p2End: . Execution patterns come from a closed, well-defined catalog - expressiveness without chaos.
Why.p3: Every run is observable through OpenTelemetry, every spec is versionable, every contract is a runtime check, not a comment in a prompt. This is the difference between a framework that produces demos and one that produces systems you can operate.

Metrics.heading: Built like infrastructure, not a demo.
Metrics.intro: Phronesis is early, but it is not thin. The surface is small on purpose - and every layer carries its own tests, types, and observability.

tests.label: Tests

modules.label: Stable modules

typing.label: Typed surface

CodeTour.heading: The API in four snippets.
CodeTour.intro: Real Python, using the public API as it stands today. The framework is in early alpha - the surface will grow, but the design will stay this lean.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: The @agent decorator binds a model, typed tools, and a system prompt into a single declarative spec.

tool.label: Tool
tool.description: Tools are typed contracts. Effects are declared so the runtime and policy code can reason about safety.

pipeline.label: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Pipelines compose runtime modes. Each step is an Executable - an agent, a callable, or a nested mode.

mcp.label: MCP
mcp.description: Connect MCP servers as first-class tool sources, exposed to agents under the same safety contracts as native tools.

composition.title: Composition over inheritance
composition.body: Agents are configured from parts - model, tools, memory, prompts - not subclassed. You assemble; you don't override.

async.title: Async-first
async.body: Streaming, concurrency, and cancellation are baseline assumptions. There is no synchronous shadow API to maintain.

typed.title: Strongly typed
typed.body: Pydantic v2 and mypy --strict throughout. Types are not documentation - they are runtime contracts the framework enforces.

immutable.title: Immutable specs, mutable runs
immutable.body: Definitions are frozen, JSON-serializable and reproducible. Execution state lives apart, observable and queryable.

observable.title: Observability built in
observable.body: OpenTelemetry spans for every agent run, tool call, and pipeline stage - from the first commit, not bolted on.

catalog.title: Closed catalog of execution patterns
catalog.body: Sequence, Parallel, Debate, Consensus, Handoff, Reflexion, Tree Search and more - nineteen named modes you can reason about, not arbitrary control flow.

Inside.heading: A small, principled surface.
Inside.intro: The framework is intentionally narrow. Each layer earns its place by either making a system safer to operate or making the code simpler to read six months later.

core.title: Core
core.description: The primitives every agent is built from.

orchestration.title: Orchestration and ops
orchestration.description: How agents compose into systems you can run.

Inside.executionModesNote: Nineteen named modes - expressive enough, finite enough to reason about.

Quality.heading: The guarantees, not the promises.
Quality.intro: An agent framework is only as trustworthy as the discipline behind it. These are the gates every change passes before it lands.

typed.title: Typed end to end
typed.description: mypy --strict and Pydantic v2 specs across the whole source tree. No untyped escape hatches.

tested.title: Tested to a floor
tested.description: 1,600+ tests with branch coverage gated at 90% - the build fails below it, never above it on paper.

deterministic.title: Deterministic replay
deterministic.description: Record once, replay forever: cassette-backed runs make agent behavior reproducible in tests and CI without a network.

observable.title: Observable by construction
observable.description: OpenTelemetry spans for every agent run, tool call, pipeline stage, and MCP session - correlated by stable ids.

immutable.title: Immutable specs
immutable.description: Agents, tools, and pipelines are frozen, JSON-serializable dataclasses - versionable, diffable, reproducible.

linted.title: Lint-clean
linted.description: ruff format and a strict ruff check gate every commit, alongside the type and test suites.

Status.heading: Phronesis is in early alpha.
Status.p1: The API will change. But the foundations are already here: typed, immutable specs; nineteen named execution modes; deterministic record and replay; OpenTelemetry from the first commit; and over 1,600 tests held to a 90% coverage floor. We build in public - no production claims, no fabricated case studies, no enterprise gates. Just the code, and an honest commitment to its design.
Status.p2: Feedback, ideas, and contributions are welcome through GitHub Discussions and Issues. The roadmap, the rough edges, and the open questions are all in the repository.
